{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_data = data[
    (data['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (data['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute the counts and fraction
n_total = len(filtered_data)
n_converted = filtered_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_total

# Print only the numbers that will be in evidence
print(n_total)
print(n_converted)
print(conversion_fraction)"}
